reviews.review: Really like this game!  The story line is cool so far and I love space/aliens and video games, so it's a win-win for me.

To put it simply: this game fails to even simply ride on its predecessor's legacy. Bought it on sale purely for multiplayer which was supposed to be an improvement over ME3 and it's the opposite.

- Horrible laggy consolized UI that any UI/UX designer should be ashamed of putting on their portfolio.
- "Communicating with server" on every action like equipping a weapon mod instead of doing it clientside and syncing with peers/server in the background like ME3 did.
- Still peer-to-peer meaning that if I play it with my friends on the other side of the world, at least one of us will have horrible latency issues, whereas in server-based games we can just play on US servers as a middle ground without issues.
- Worse netcode than ME3. At higher latency, enemies that are supposed to be dead constantly stick around at zero health and "shoot" at you (without actually dealing damage), but still distracting. You constantly get teleported back even when walking, not to mention sprinting, dodging or jumping.
- No hard cover, which in ME3 was a godsend because it allowed to reset your position [b]on host[/b] and remove latency-caused movement jitter at least for a while.
- New movement abilities (jetpack, slam) function poorly and feel extremely clunky compared to other games from that era featuring them.
- Awful character design. You have to actively [b]try[/b] to make asari ugly, but they succeeded.
- Awful sound design. Guns sound cheap, biotic and fire explosions are a faint echo of their ME3 iterations that inspired you to run biotic and tech tag teams just to enjoy the reverb booms tearing enemies apart.
- Uninspired and generic aesthetics that I wouldn't even recognize as Mass Effect if I saw them somewhere out of the game.

Not worth it even on sale. Not worth it even for free. Just not worth your time. There are much, much better co-op MP experiences nowadays out there. I'd refund it on principle, but I'm sadly over the playtime limit.
It was very repetitive. If I wasn't in a cutscene I was running and shooting ailiens. If you pick it up during a sale it might be worth it, if you like running, shooting and a (somewhat) good story.
Graphics were OK but the storyline was terrible. UI interation and relationships were minimal at best. Original Mass Effect was hands down better. I do not recommend this game.

Being a huge fan of the original trilogy (yes even the third one) I was looking forward to playing this but after seeing the terrible launch I decided to wait for some patches and a discount.

After some years I found the opportunity to check it out with the EA Play subscription(which is really nice by the way although you will run out of great games pretty quickly).

After playing for quite some hours and finishing almost everything I have come to the conclusion that this is at best a mediocre game and specifically a bad mass effect game.

The good:
+ Good looking environments.
+ Fun gunplay and abilities.
+ Interesting setting.
+ Decent soundtrack.
+ Pretty good gear.
+ Some memorable story and side quest moments.

The bad:
- Ugly faces.
- Clunky animations.
- A bit convoluted story.
- Bad voice acting (for the most part) or bad voice acting direction?
- Very few meaningful choices.
- Terrible dialog wheel.
- Way too many meaningless side quests and collectables.
- Very few species and alien variety.
- Annoying crew mates with bland personalities and uninteresting interactions.(One of the worst offenses)
- Bad planet navigation.
- Huge time wasted traveling from planet to planet and leaving and entering your ship for minor quest progression.
- Uninteresting protagonist.
- Disappointing conclusion to many quests.
- A general feeling that you are wasting your time on many occasions doing dull and unimportant chores or doing things you have no say in.

In conclusion Andromeda for some reason is a considerable downgrade from the previous mass effect games improving honestly only in gun fights and biotic abilities and overall being worse in almost every other aspect and you are left with a sour taste that all charm the original trilogy had its now gone. Another example that Bioware has lost its touch and as far as I am concerned I will not be looking forward to the sequel or any other new game developed by them.

Final score 5/10.

Do not let the review turn u away from this game. 
It is a damn good rpg game in it own way.
